title: Spotted Bat (NPS Sound Gallery)
author: National Park Service
changes: Spotted bat (Euderma maculatum), whose calls are audible to humans. Trimmed to 2.15–5.10 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), peaks limited by 2.0 dB, 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
